newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intria cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intria cut to hold.

text.p: Mohaiyani Research said on Friday that it has downgraded its rating on construction concern Intria Bhd to hold from long-term buy, citing expectations of delays in the startup of projects.

In a report, Mohaiyani said it had anticipated revenue from construction projects of more than 250 million ringgit for fiscal year 1997 ending in June, but now estimates that to be about 60 million ringgit after talking to the company.
Construction project revenue will rise to about 280 million ringgit in fiscal 1998, Mohaiyani said. Intria officials were not immediately available for comment.

The Intria group's current order book is worth 1.5 billion ringgit, including construction of houses in the central state of Melaka and southern Johor state for associate companies Metacorp Bhd and Prolink, respectively, Mohaiyani said.

The construction contract with Metacorp is worth about 2.5 billion ringgit over 10 years. "However, the timing and value of construction works for each stage of the project are subject to Metacorp's approval," the report said.
Thus, Mohaiyani said it is valuing the Metacorp-linked projects at 1.0 billion ringgit over five years. "Intria has yet to secure other major projects," it added.
